Vitamin C

Vitamin immune-support antioxidant infection collagen

Evidence: peer_reviewed

Summary

Water-soluble antioxidant and immune-system support; supports collagen synthesis and white blood cell function.

Indications

  • infection
  • immune deficiency
  • scurvy
  • wound healing
  • fatigue
  • sensitivity to cold

Contraindications

  • kidney stones (high doses)
  • hemochromatosis

Preparations

  • powder
  • tablet
  • capsule
  • ascorbate (buffered)

Body Systems Affected

  • immune
  • circulatory
  • integumentary
